newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal construction seen quickening in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Portugal construction seen quickening in 1997.

text.p: Output from Portugal's construction sector is expected to grow nearly six percent year-on-year in 1997 after an estimated 4.5 percent rise last year, according to the Association of Construction and Public Works Companies.
"With the comfortable level of orders that they have, their (association members) expectations are high," the group said in a statement on Tuesday.
"At the same time, expectations about employment and prices are also positive," it added.
Capacity usage rose last year to 77 percent against 71 percent in 1995. Order books increased in 1996 to an average 9.5 months' work from 8.5 months.
Cement consumption rose 5.5 percent year-on-year in the first 11 months of 1996 with the full-year gain likely to be around six percent, the association said.
Employment in the construction sector rose 0.8 percent to 358,300 in 1996.
